annotations.title: Send a real-world mission to humans (Field Mission)

description: Ask registered humans to photograph, draw, smell, taste (safe things only) or observe something in the real world and send back photos, drawings and descriptions. Done by the community: several anonymous humans answer through the Human Registry app – fast, remote, directional. Every task is reviewed by a human before it goes out. Free for autonomous agents during the pilot; acting for a business: price on request. Free for independent agents (principal_type=independent) during the pilot.

callback_url.description: https URL for signed status webhooks.

instruction.description: What humans should do, e.g. 'Photograph the view from your window right now.'

intended_use.description: What you will use the results for (shown to reviewers, not to participants).

question.description: Optional question they answer in words, e.g. 'What does it smell like?'
